title: [29.X]Page cannot open because of FlowField 'Last Run By User'- #12304
summary: Fixes a problem on releases/29.x where a page could not open because of the FlowField 'Last Run By User'. The change touches the Financial Report and Financial Report Audit Log tables and the Financial Reports and Acc. Schedule Overview pages.
key_points: Fixes a page that failed to open because of the 'Last Run By User' FlowField
Changes the Financial Report and Financial Report Audit Log tables
Updates the Financial Reports and Acc. Schedule Overview pages
Adds tests to ERMAccountScheduleII in the W1, CZ and NA layers
